bio.greeting-role: 3D Artist, Industrial Designer & Additive Manufacturing Specialist
bio.intro: I professionally bridge the gap between digital 3D art, reverse engineering, and physical manufacturing. I am just as passionate about creating optimized game-ready environments for Unreal Engine as I am about engineering precise, functional components for automotive tuning followed by 3D printing.
bio.focus-text: Full-pipeline 3D creation (from concept and sculpting to shaders and game engines), reverse engineering from scans, additive manufacturing (FDM, SLA, SLS), and CNC machining.
bio.impact-text: With dozens of commercial projects under my belt, I also drive high-impact implementations. For instance, a project I developed for the Ural Federal University saved the institution $100K, with roadmaps successfully pitched to top-level management and state officials.
bio.think-1: For me, 3D is much more than just a pretty picture on a screen. I think in terms of production, ergonomics, and optimization. If it's a game asset, it will be optimized for the engine; if it's a physical-world component, it will be engineered with material strength and printing technologies (FDM/SLA/SLS) in mind.
bio.think-2: Beyond creating graphics, I also teach: sharing my expertise with future engineers at Russian Railways (RZD) and guiding students from initial sketches to finished physical prototypes.
bio.closing: I am open to remote work, relocation, and exciting international projects. Let's create something awesome together!
